name: Hailuo-Music-v1.5
description:
Generate music from text prompts using the MiniMax model, which leverages advanced AI techniques to create high-quality, diverse musical compositions. 

Notes: 
Send the lyrics of the music over as your prompt. 
Both prompt/lyrics and style must be sent over for best quality.
The prompt supports [intro][verse][chorus][bridge][outro] sections.

Optional parameters:
Set music style to set the style of the generated music - for example, rock and roll, hip-hop, etc.
